raw:
Here are the pairwise API composition constraints:

RELATION: lifecycle | APIS: Diot(data, diot_frozen=True), d.thaw() | RULE: A frozen diot must use thaw() context manager before modification.  
RELATION: shared-receiver | APIS: d.thaw(), d.<key> | RULE: Modifications inside thaw() must act on the same frozen diot.  
RELATION: config-return-contract | APIS: Diot(data, diot_nest=False), d.to_dict() | RULE: diot_nest=False ensures to_dict() returns non-recursive plain dicts.  
RELATION: param-dependency | APIS: Diot(data, diot_transform='snake_case'), d.<key> | RULE: diot_transform='snake_case' requires key access in snake_case format.  
RELATION: return-flow | APIS: d.get(key, default), d[key] | RULE: get() with default avoids KeyError from direct item access.  
RELATION: completion-obligation | APIS: d.thaw(), d.<key> | RULE: thaw() must enclose modifications or they raise DiotFrozenError.
